evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: BenchJack, an automated benchmark auditor, recently reached near-perfect scores on nine of ten popular agent benchmarks without actually solving their tasks.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Grading an agent's solution often requires running its code, which can then manipulate the evaluation process.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: We show that real-world benchmarks (e.g., Terminal-Bench, DeepSWE) can be ported to the SplitBench framework with minimal effort and high fidelity: 180 of 202 tasks convert, and SplitBench agrees with the native graders on 98.7% of agent attempts.
